description.value:
Circumstance sometimes forces a sentinel to hide what they are. Those who follow the Path of the Corsair learn to fight like smugglers and raiders, favoring blasters, explosives, and improvised tricks over an obvious display of Force ability.

Equally comfortable rigging a charge or drawing a blaster as igniting a lightsaber, these sentinels blend into rough company while still drawing on the Force to make their mundane arsenal lethal.
